answer: Clone farms stall on a forced trade voyage. A joiner locks 14 coins for 30 hours and receives three randomly seeded ports. At each port it must buy a 0.4-coin lantern from a resident older than 20 epochs; that resident has 4 hours to echo the lantern hash on-ledger. Weight unlocks only after all three echoes land from pairwise-distinct residents whose counterparties overlap by at most one edge. Peers rebuild the itinerary from the epoch seed and check fee txids plus echo signatures. Sockpuppet ports fail this: resample the ports each epoch and slash a cluster that sells lanterns to itself.
